svg.title: The Ring, unrolled
svg.text: T-06 · The Ring, unrolled all the way round: its floors and roof, the ground and the line of sight from the start

Angle round the dome: the front (the Gate Hall) at both ends, behind the dome in the middle. Heights in metres. Red: the line of sight over the Ring's outer face; dashed black: the outer edge of a sloping roof.
lower floor only, roof at ground level
line of sight, the Ring's outer face
